title: Live demo: research, build, browser-test, PDF report
message:
Work in your workspace and do all four steps:
1. Research: use web_search and then web_fetch on a good source to find out what HTTP status code 418 means and which RFC defined it. Note the source URLs.
2. Build a small web app in /workspace/app: index.html plus app.js, an 'HTTP status lookup' page with a text input and a button; typing a code (at least 10 common codes, including 418) shows its name and a one-line meaning. Serve it in the background with: cd /workspace/app && nohup python3 -m http.server 8000 >/tmp/server.log 2>&1 &
3. Test it with the browser tool: open http://localhost:8000, type 418 into the input, click the button, check the page shows "I'm a teapot", and take a screenshot.
4. Write a short report at /workspace/report.md (findings with source URLs, what you built, the test result) and convert it to /workspace/report.pdf with convert_file.
Reply with the paths of the PDF and the screenshot.
